# Eternal Life Hospice

> Eternal Life Hospice is a Medicare-certified, CDPH-licensed, and ACHC-accredited hospice care provider serving Ventura County and Los Angeles County, California. We provide compassionate, physician-directed end-of-life care wherever home is — private residences, assisted living, skilled nursing, and residential care facilities — with same-day admissions and 24/7 on-call nursing.

## Contact
- Phone (24/7 admissions): 805.953.7273
- Address: 4165 E Thousand Oaks Blvd, Suite 325B, Westlake Village, CA 91362
- Website: https://eternallifehospice.com

## Services
- Hospice care: physician-directed, nurse-coordinated comfort care
- Pain and symptom management
- Integrative and comfort therapies: music therapy, aromatherapy, massage, reiki, sound bath, pet therapy, audiology support, and end-of-life doula companionship
- Spiritual and emotional support for patients and families
- Bereavement and grief support
- Cost: covered by the Medicare Hospice Benefit — most patients pay little to nothing out of pocket

## Coverage Area
Serving 2 counties and 135+ communities across Ventura County and Los Angeles County, including Thousand Oaks, Westlake Village, Camarillo, Oxnard, Ventura, Simi Valley, Moorpark, Newbury Park, Agoura Hills, Calabasas, Malibu, Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, Sherman Oaks, Encino, Tarzana, and Woodland Hills.

## About
Eternal Life Hospice is an independent, compliance-led hospice built on The Eternal Standard — four pillars of care: Clinical Confidence, Guided Presence, Whole-Person Comfort, and Compliance-Led Care. Tagline: "Care That Honors Life."
